verdict.rationale_short: (0) ★★★ MUSCAT TALKS INCONCLUSIVE — PRIMARY WEEKEND DEVELOPMENT — Iranian FM Araghchi's Saturday July 18 meeting in Muscat with Omani FM Badr al-Busaidi produced no ceasefire and no Hormuz reopening agreement. Oman is drafting a tentative traffic-management proposal; France and UK are studying a navigational-fee framework with UN IMO backing. This is not a ceasefire — it is the beginning of a protracted diplomatic track. The weekend binary from the prior briefing (ceasefire → Brent −5–8% at Sunday futures open; Iranian rejection → Brent toward $90+) did not trigger cleanly: the outcome is 'talks continuing,' which keeps oil risk fully embedded. Brent settled at $85.95 Friday and WTI above $80 formal trigger; August CPI oil-shock path remains loaded. Hormuz tanker traffic at multi-month lows (~7 vessels/day vs. 13 pre-crisis). The STEP ASIDE energy headwind is unresolved. (1) ★★★ GOOGL Q2 EARNINGS TUESDAY JULY 22 AMC — THE WEEK'S DEFINING BINARY — Analysts: EPS $2.86–$2.95 (vs. Q1 blowout $5.11); revenue $116.8B–$120.2B. Google Cloud backlog nearly doubled QoQ to $460B in Q1 (63% YoY growth). Key watch: Cloud revenue acceleration/deceleration vs. Q1's 63%; AI Overviews monetization signal; Gemini 3.5 Pro delay headwind (Bloomberg: 'months behind schedule'); Wiz acquisition margin drag (low single-digit %); YouTube ad demand. BofA maintains Buy / $440 PT implying ~19% upside. Prediction markets pricing 97% beat probability. GOOGL closed essentially flat Thursday when NVDA fell 7%+ — the market is treating it as the cleanest AI monetization proxy in mega-cap tech. BEAT + strong Q3 guidance = direct refutation of Kimi K3 AI-fatigue thesis, sector re-rating 3–5%; this verdict upgrades to HOLD/SELECTIVE. MISS = Kimi K3 demand-destruction narrative validated on fundamentals; STEP ASIDE deepens and chip position-clearing accelerates. No position change until Tuesday AMC. (2) ★★ KIMI K3 — SOX BEAR MARKET UNCHANGED THROUGH WEEKEND — PHLX Semiconductor Index remains in official bear market (−20%+ from late-June record high; −11% for the week of July 14). No positive AI demand data emerged over Saturday–Sunday. NVDA ~$201 (−10.5% cumulative from $212.50); AMD, ARM, Marvell, and Intel all in bear market territory. The Kimi K3 efficiency shock ($15/M output tokens vs. Anthropic $50/M) is unquantified in any sell-side demand model — the market continues to price tail risk on AI capex ROI with no anchor. Dead zone for chips until GOOGL reports Tuesday. Do not add to semiconductor exposure in the Monday session. (3) ★★ TESLA Q2 EARNINGS — ALSO THIS WEEK — Tesla reports in the week of July 20 (date/time to be confirmed; tentatively Wednesday or Thursday AMC). Key watch: EV delivery vs. consensus, FSD/Autopilot revenue recognition, energy storage segment margins, China delivery mix. Not a direct chip-demand read but a proxy for AI-capex sentiment in the autonomous/robotics complex. Any miss amplifies the AI-fatigue narrative; a beat provides partial offset. (4) ★★ PYPL BOARD RESPONSE MONDAY JULY 20 — Stripe/Advent $60.50/share ($53B) bid. Board response expected Monday July 20 pre-open. PYPL ~$55 holding the deal spread (~$5.50). Binary: board engages = spread tightens to $58–59; board rejects = stock to $45–48. Pure event-driven catalyst — no position change before Monday pre-market. (5) ★ BTC GATE 2 FIRMLY HELD — RECOVERING — Live BTC $64,714 (+1.09%, 24h low $63,935) at 07:35 UTC Sunday per Crypto.com MCP live data. Gate 2 ($62,000 trigger) now 4.4% below current price — comfortably held and trending away from the threshold. BTC continues to decouple from the semiconductor complex; crypto risk appetite is stabilizing. Gate 2 protocol remains on standby but is no longer the imminent tail risk it was Friday.

bear_case: Counter-thesis for a Monday or post-Tuesday upgrade to HOLD/SELECTIVE: Four converging signals could reverse the STEP ASIDE call. (1) GOOGL BEATS AND RE-RATES THE SECTOR (HIGHEST PROBABILITY BULL PATH) — Alphabet has beaten consensus EPS in each of the past four quarters, including Q1's $5.11 blowout vs. $2.87 est. If Q2 Cloud revenue accelerates vs. Q1's 63% YoY and AI Overviews monetization shows a discernible ramp, GOOGL directly refutes the Kimi K3 AI-fatigue narrative on live fundamental data. The market has already designated GOOGL as the AI monetization proxy (closed flat while NVDA fell 7%+) — a beat could re-rate semis 3–5% in a single session Tuesday evening. Upgrade to HOLD/SELECTIVE immediately on GOOGL beat + positive Q3 guidance. (2) MUSCAT DIPLOMATIC ACCELERATION — The Muscat talks on Saturday were inconclusive but not a breakdown. Oman's tentative traffic-management proposal and France/UK navigational-fee framework represent a structured diplomatic path. Any weekend-into-Monday signal that Hormuz reopening talks are gaining momentum could compress Brent 3–5% at Sunday futures open and remove the primary August CPI headwind. A Brent move below $82 on confirmed Hormuz progress = reduce XLE, upgrade market read. (3) DEEPSEEK JANUARY REPLAY — In January 2026, DeepSeek triggered a near-identical chip selloff (SOX fell to −20% territory); the sector recovered fully within three weeks as hyperscaler AI capex spending data confirmed demand had not slowed. The Meta-Anthropic $10B compute lease deal announced last week is a real-time, large-scale refutation of the 'AI capex is slowing' narrative. If Kimi K3 is efficiency innovation that expands AI adoption (consistent with the DeepSeek pattern) rather than demand destruction, the semiconductor selloff from $212.50 NVDA to $201 is the buying opportunity, not the beginning of a structural decline. (4) BTC STABILITY AS CROSS-ASSET SIGNAL — BTC at $64,714 (+1.09%, Gate 2 firmly held at $62K) is decoupling from the semiconductor complex. In prior cycles, BTC holding at Gate 2 while semis sell off has been a leading indicator that broad risk appetite has not broken — the semiconductor sell-off is idiosyncratic (AI narrative) rather than a macro regime shift. Invalidation conditions for STEP ASIDE: SPX reclaims two consecutive closes above 7,480; NVDA holds $205+ intraday; Brent reverses below $83 on Hormuz progress signal. Any two of three = upgrade to HOLD/SELECTIVE.
